items.item: One Rapier body for the figure; the eyes and the matter answer to it through the rig and are not bodies
Rapier owns the holder's pose; the rig owns the visor's local transform; the field and the painters are unchanged
items.evidence: src/components/face/driver.ts move(): the body gives the holder's position only. engine.ts carryMotion(): tilt, trail, squash and lids as per-frame rig offsets

items.item: A fixed 1/60 s step with bounded catch-up and interpolation between steps
items.evidence: body.ts advance(); body.test.ts: a ten-second frame runs at most five steps, and the pose between steps is interpolated

items.item: A spring tether brings the body to its anchor and settles it there
items.evidence: body.ts tether(): JointData.spring for stiffness, the body's linear damping to settle. body.test.ts: rests exactly on the anchor; travel after a throw arrives

items.item: Carried, it follows the hand; released with speed it continues a little and settles; released at rest it stays
items.evidence: body.test.ts (held, slow release, moving release, cap). Browser: 220.8 px coast at ~940 px/s with person.throw; 0 px with person.drop

items.item: A thrown figure meets the window's edges, and the face answers the contact on the side that was struck
items.evidence: body.test.ts: one right bump, stays inside. face.test.ts: knock, squash and the near eye for each side. Browser: body.bump.right; docs/plans/evidence/theo-body/thrown.png

items.item: Sent to an artifact, it looks there first, then travels, then settles beside it
items.evidence: program.ts place "artifact"; book.ts "visit"; driver.ts go() and pointOf(). face.test.ts: visit looks before it goes. Browser: eyes at ~49 ms, body at ~716 ms, 12 px beside the card; docs/plans/evidence/theo-body/visit.png

items.item: A poke or a collision gives a bounded recoil, a brief asymmetric eye response and a recovery, weighed by the face's state
items.evidence: body.test.ts: recoil 3 to 24 px, returns exactly. face.test.ts: poke asymmetry; calm and wound up draw different reactions. Browser: 9.8 px and back

items.item: The person's drag outranks autonomous travel
items.evidence: driver.ts go() returns while carried. Browser: a go during a carry moves it 0 px from the hand

items.item: Scrolling and resizing move the anchor and the body with it, with no velocity and no event
items.evidence: body.ts shift(); body.test.ts (resting and mid-trip). Browser: 123 px of scroll, on its perch every frame, no event

items.item: Reduced motion has no body, coast, recoil or lean; asleep ignores what happens to the body
items.evidence: driver.ts physical(); engine.ts notice(). face.test.ts: reduced motion moves nothing; asleep ignores body.*. Browser with reduced motion: no coast, a poke moves it 0 px

items.item: Nothing the body does is, or produces, a sign that a request is advancing
items.evidence: face.test.ts: travel, a throw and a bump produce no run event and leave liveness as it was

items.item: Without Rapier the earlier glide carries the figure
items.evidence: driver.ts: the glide path is unchanged and is what runs until the body loads. Not seen with a load that fails in a browser

items.item: A carry and a throw by a real hand on a real display, for feel
items.evidence: Not done here. The headless page ran at about 13 frames a second; throws were made with dispatched pointer events carrying set timestamps

Obstacles other than the window's edges

items.evidence: Not built. The place and the performance exist for the agent and for rules
